title: Product research
standfirst: What the research layer is designed to do, what it can do today, and the three gates standing between those two states.

gateSummary.requirement: Creators API access. Requires Associates enrollment plus at least 10 qualifying sales in the trailing 30 days.
gateSummary.detail: PA-API 5 is deprecated and returns HTTP 403. The replacement API is gated behind a sales threshold this account has not evidenced.

gateSummary.requirement: Price and availability may only be shown if Amazon serves the link containing them, or the data arrives via Creators API or PA API under the License.
gateSummary.detail: Until API access exists, no price, discount or availability figure can be shown to a reader.

gateSummary.requirement: Star ratings and customer reviews may only be used if obtained through Creators API or PA API.
gateSummary.detail: Observed ratings are therefore held in the internal register only, never rendered on a buyer-facing page.

designedCapabilities.designed: Rank candidate categories by the count of verifiable buying questions that can be answered without price data.
designedCapabilities.today: Done by hand for two categories: air fryers and thermometers.

designedCapabilities.designed: Compare search interest across candidate categories on a rolling basis.
designedCapabilities.today: Not running. No data source connected.

designedCapabilities.designed: Track observed price over time to spot unusual movement.
designedCapabilities.today: Not permissible. Blocked by the price-display rule absent API access.

designedCapabilities.designed: Survey which questions already have strong published answers.
designedCapabilities.today: Manual reading, recorded in the content plan.

designedCapabilities.designed: Estimate earnings per click from category rates.
designedCapabilities.today: Deliberately not built. Any figure would be a guess dressed as analysis.

designedCapabilities.designed: Draft question-shaped guides from verified source material.
designedCapabilities.today: In use, with every claim traced to a source in the register and every untested statement labelled.

designedCapabilities.designed: Store intended ASIN and official listing separately from observed redirects.
designedCapabilities.today: Built. The register keeps the two fields apart and refuses to merge them.

designedCapabilities.designed: Count the five defined events without identifiers.
designedCapabilities.today: Client-side only. No collector is deployed, so counts are not yet retained.

designedCapabilities.designed: Build the static site, sitemap and feed from one data file.
designedCapabilities.today: Working. One command rebuilds every page.

designedCapabilities.designed: Fail the build if a required disclosure is missing from any generated page.

scoringNote: No product score, opportunity score or revenue forecast is published. The inputs that would make such a score meaningful do not exist, and a number invented to look analytical is worse than no number.
